question: Should ecommerce implement this as one approved shared CategoryHub redesign now, and what exact design/copy scope from the external template is in bounds?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the change is a broad storefront layout, SEO, and responsive-design feature rather than a narrow broken-behavior fix.

options.title: Approve shared redesign
options.body: Implement the four minihomes through shared CategoryHub subcomponents with explicit desktop/mobile visual QA and per-route copy data.

options.title: Split into staged PRs
options.body: Land hero/benefits, embedded catalog, and SEO/interlinking as separate reviewed increments if the team wants lower merge risk.

options.title: Defer design work
options.body: Keep the current minihomes until ecommerce has a finalized internal design spec that replaces the external template.

recommendation.title: Approve shared redesign
recommendation.body: Implement the four minihomes through shared CategoryHub subcomponents with explicit desktop/mobile visual QA and per-route copy data.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CategoryHub discovery/interlinking work makes Alex the strongest routing candidate for the shared minihome surface.
